description.narrative: The expected project-level outcomes include increasing access to electricity by expanding total domestic generation and lowering the cost of electricity generation in Benin. Beyond such effects, the Project will diversify Benins generation mix and provide significant demonstration effects as the first solar IPPs in the country, which can set the country on a path to reduce reliance on electricity imports.

The proposed investment consists of the development, financing, construction, operation and maintenance of four greenfield, solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants in Benin, bundled into two Lots: (i) Lot A includes the Natitingou power plant (10 MWAC) and the Djougou power plant (10 MWAC); and (ii) Lot B includes the Parakou power plant (15 MWAC) and the Bohicon power plant (15 MWAC). The electricity generated by the plants will be sold to the Société Béninoise de Production dÉlectricité (SBPE), the state-owned power utility, under four separate 20-year Power Purchase Agreements (one for each power plant).

name.narrative: The Parakou plant is located in the centre-west of Benin, about 340km north of Porto-Novo, the capital of Benin. The Bohicon plant is located near the cities of Bohicon and Abomey and about 100km north-west of Porto-Novo. The Natitingou plant is located southwest of the town of Natitingou, about 520km from Porto-Novo. The Djougou plant is located south of the town of Djougou, about 420km from Porto-Novo.
